messages:
Sam: Quick sync: support funnel shows customers get a plain 5xx with "model-mismatch" and no guidance. Can we standardize a tiny machine-readable field so console + docs can show a helpful prompt, not raw JSON?
Jin: yep. We've debated adding too many fields before. Keep it to 3-4 keys. My suggestion: `failure_category` (enum), `user_facing_hint` (string), `action_key` (string), `debug_id` (string).
Priya: action_key is important for i18n and consistent CTAs. Example mapping: `request_quota`, `switch_model`, `retry_later`, `contact_support`.
Sam: +1. Also need to decide which categories map to HTTP statuses. e.g., quota => 429, capacity => 503, auth => 401. We must avoid leaking internal routing reasons in the status text.
Jin: For telemetry correlation, emit a short `debug_id` and also metric tag `failure_category` so dashboards can pivot. We should avoid making `user_facing_hint` a substitute for telemetry - it's for the human console only.
Priya: rollout idea: server returns `failure_category` for all responses in a staging header `x-rw-fc` first, then we flip into response body after 2 weeks. Allows SDKs to adapt.
Sam: good. We also need a lint rule so new endpoints are scanned. deploy-bot: can you enforce?
deploy-bot: note: adding server lint check: new endpoints must include `failure_category` or opt-out label. Linter will warn for 14 days, then fail. See #rfc-errors-2026.
Jin: small schema example for response body (for frontend parsing):
```json
{
  "status": 503,
  "error_code": "model_mismatch",
  "failure_category": "fallback",
  "action_key": "switch_model",
  "user_facing_hint": "Routing to a smaller model in this region. Consider pinning a model for consistent latency.",
  "debug_id": "dbg-4c2f"
}
```
Priya: note about PII/security: `user_facing_hint` must not include internal hostnames or tenant ids. If we want to show region, use a sanitized tag like `region:eu-west`.
Sam: agreed. Also add console metric `console.hint_clicks` and `console.action_outcome` to track whether CTA helped.
Jin: we should define fallback vs capacity vs quota vs auth vs transient. I'll draft a minimal enum doc and share.
Priya: UX ask: make hint length <= 120 chars and prefer an inline link to modal instead of dumping long message. i18n team will supply translations keyed by `action_key`.
Sam: ops-bot: put a dashboard tile to measure percent of 5xx with empty `failure_category`. Need baseline.
ops-bot: acknowledged. Dashboard card created: "5xx missing failure_category". Alerts set to p95 > 10% for 7 days.
Jin: implementation note: runtime layers must map internal signals to the public enum. We should include mapping table in the PR.
Priya: action items: Jin -> enum + mapping table; Sam -> linter change request; Priya -> i18n CTA list; deploy-bot -> announce lint timeline.
Sam: thanks all. If we can ship this without changing consumer SDKs, even better. We'll aim for a non-breaking body addition and header staging as discussed. :rocket:
